levels.name: Sunny Meadowlands
levels.description: Sun-drenched grassy hills with gentle tutorial platforms, acorn patrol, and waterfall chasm.

levels.name: Whispering Woods
levels.description: Vertical canopy ascent with swaying moss boughs, one-way leaf platforms, and rhythmic Spore Hoppers.

levels.name: Bioluminescent Caverns
levels.description: Subterranean glowing mushroom launchpads, hazardous amethyst crystal spikes, and Glow Bat flyers.

levels.name: Gusty Highland Cliffs
levels.description: Mountain precipice featuring soaring thermal updrafts, collapsing cloud ledges, and aggressive Bramble Chargers.

levels.name: The Elder Canopy & Boss Arena
levels.description: Master obstacle gauntlet leading to Willow Owl's rest, the Bramblethorn Golem Coliseum, and the Great Sunburst Ending Altar.

enemyTypes.name: Acorn Walker
enemyTypes.behavior: Patrols platforms with edge detection, turns around at cliffs and walls.

enemyTypes.name: Spore Hopper
enemyTypes.behavior: Rhythmic squash telegraph for 0.25s, jumps vertically 62px, creates airborne timing challenge.

enemyTypes.name: Glow Bat Flyer
enemyTypes.behavior: Smooth sine-wave aerial patrol, casts bioluminescent aura, allows chaining stomp-hops.

enemyTypes.name: Bramble Charger
enemyTypes.behavior: Alerts on line-of-sight, winds up for 0.4s and charges. Crashes into walls and stuns for 2.2s where it becomes vulnerable to stomps.

phases.description: Leaps and slams ground creating horizontal shockwave. Core opens on floor for 3.5s.
Fires bouncing thorny briar balls. Slam shockwaves are faster. Core opens for 2.6s.
Double shockwave slams, canopy briar stalactites barrage, enraged charge into wall causing 2.2s stun.

npcs.name: Barnaby Snail
dialogue: Well met, young Pip! The Great Sunburst Tree has grown dim, and brambles choke the upper boughs.
Gather the 5 Sun Berries in each region to restore its light. Press [Space] to Jump, and tap [Shift] or [J] mid-air for a Meadow Dash!
Keep a keen eye out for secret alcoves behind thick ivy curtains. Safe travels, little sprite!

npcs.name: Willow Owl
dialogue: Hoo-hoo! You have climbed far, little Pip. Ahead lies the Bramblethorn Golem.
Its thorny armor deflects all attacks while it charges! You must leap over its ground shockwaves and let it exhaust itself.
When it crashes or kneels, strike its glowing Heart Core from above. Restore the canopy!

npcs.name: Elder Root Spirit
dialogue: Pip, bravest of sprites! The bramble corruption has dissolved, and the Great Sunburst Tree blazes with life once more.
Your heroic journey is inscribed in the canopy forever!
May the warm light of the meadow guide you always, Meadow Champion!

medallions.name: Medallion of Dawn
medallions.lore: In the morning light of the first age, the Sunburst Tree sprouted from a single fallen star.

medallions.name: Medallion of Whispers
medallions.lore: The canopy winds remember every song sung by the sprites of old.

medallions.name: Medallion of Luminescence
medallions.lore: Deep beneath the roots, glowing crystals drink the earth's quiet warmth.

medallions.name: Medallion of Zephyr
medallions.lore: High atop the cliffs, the mountain gale carries the seeds of new beginnings.

medallions.name: Medallion of the Ancients
medallions.lore: When all five blessings unite, the slumbering forest awakens in eternal bloom.
